style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: big COBALT-BLUE vest, round glasses, red party cone, cane on his wing. Calm. Wings hold ONE white cake with lit wax numbers 6 and 5; ONE plain blue booklet lies open on his head.
second_characters: ONE mole clerk, MUSTARD-YELLOW suit, clean white sleeves, ONE big round stamp. Queue by the wall, blue booklet on each head: old sheep knee-deep in the floor, old turtle waist-deep, old duck chest-deep.
props: Stamp: mole's, print is an ink ring with a star. Cake 6-5: goose's until 8.2 s, mole's from 8.8 s. Round tile patches in the floor, each with the same print.
environment: Pension office: CORAL-and-white checker floor, MINT-GREEN walls, barred cash window, clock with hands only.
lighting: Warm key on goose's face, cyan rim left, magenta rim right. Blue vest and red cone vivid in every shot, close-ups too.
motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose alone, dry deadpan adult voice 0.6-7.0 s, beak free while speaking; no speech after 7.0 s

timeline.a: From the first frame, already: mole's paw slams the stamp on the booklet on goose's head; goose sinks knee-deep into cracking tile, the wax 6 and 5 flicker.
timeline.c: hurls itself down with the stamp, close-up

timeline.a: Goose lifts his head, beak free, squares the booklet with a wingtip, cake level; mole lifts the stamp. Floor before the window: tile patches with the stamp print.
timeline.c: whips round behind the window, bars in foreground

timeline.a: Second BANG; goose sinks waist-deep, beak free; wings jerk open, fold back.
timeline.c: tumbles down to the floor, low angle

timeline.a: Goose looks up, beak free; the old queue waits at three depths, patches visible beside the queue; turtle pulls its head in.
Goose neck-deep, beak free, wings raised over his head hold the cake up; mole climbs onto the sill.
timeline.c: dives between the wax 6 and 5, close-up

timeline.a: Goose's head at tile level by the wax 6 and 5, beak free. On the sill above, mole's claws make one digging stroke in the air; he dusts his clean sleeves, lifts the stamp.
timeline.c: rolls flat onto the tiles, close-up

timeline.a: Mole jumps off the sill and slams the stamp down with all his weight; goose goes into the floor whole, his red cone spins on the tile.
timeline.c: plunges with the stamp into the hole, close-up

timeline.a: Goose's wing rises from the hole, sets the cake level on the tile, sinks.
timeline.c: rockets back out, cake in foreground

timeline.a: Mole blows out the wax 6 and 5 in one puff and tucks the cake under his arm.
timeline.c: swings in to the smoke, close-up

timeline.a: Mole slides a tile patch over the hole with his foot and stamps it. A long row of the same patches before the window. Last frame: mole raises the stamp over the old sheep's booklet, still moving.
timeline.c: flies up to the ceiling, top-down

negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, letters, English speech, foreign accent, slow speech, static camera, locked-off shots, muted colors, duplicate props, extra limbs, extra characters beyond those listed, character changing appearance mid-shot, blood, humans
